What he then blabs out of the school is that the most universal, the doing of reason, turns for him into the most particular, into an idiosyncrasy of Messrs. Fichte and Schelling. - No less must he to whom the Reinholdian love and faith is not clear for itself, and to whom Reinhold has nothing to say about it, behold him in the magic circle of an arcanum whose possessor, as representative of love and faith, pretends to be equipped precisely with a special sense, - an arcanum that presented and exhibited itself in the consciousness of this extraordinary individual and wanted to publish itself in the world of the senses through the outline of logic and the contributions working on it, etc.
zh: 如果赖因霍尔德认为自己靠一个公设就免除了任何进一步的言说，那么他反倒觉得费希特先生和谢林先生居然也提出公设是件怪事；他们的公设在他看来是某些非凡个体的意识中的一种特异反应，这些个体为此具备特殊的感官，而纯粹理性本身就在他们的著作中发表了它行动着的知识和知着的行动。72) 赖因霍尔德也相信（S. 143），自己曾置身于这个魔法圈中，已经走了出来，并且现在有能力把秘密公开出来。

他从学派里喋喋不休泄露出来的东西就是：最普遍的东西、即理性的作为，在他那里变成了最特殊的东西，变成了费希特先生和谢林先生的一种特异反应。——那些觉得赖因霍尔德式的爱和信仰本身并不清楚、而赖因霍尔德对此又无话可说的人，同样必定会把他看作处在一种秘传之物的魔法圈中：这种秘传之物的占有者作为爱和信仰的代表，恰恰自称具备特殊的感官，——这种秘传之物在这个非凡个体的意识中呈现并展示自身，并且想通过逻辑的纲要和加工这纲要的文稿在感性世界里公布自己，等等。

en: The postulate of love and faith sounds somewhat more agreeable and gentler than such an odd demand for a transcendental intuition.
A public can be more edified by a gentle postulate but be repelled by the rough postulate of transcendental intuition; only this contributes nothing to the main matter.
zh: 爱和信仰的公设，听起来比先验直观那样一种古怪的要求要舒服些、温和些。
公众可以被一个温和的公设更多地教化，却会被先验直观这个粗硬的公设推开；不过这对主要事情毫无贡献。

en: We now come to the main presupposition, which finally touches philosophizing more immediately.

That which philosophy must provisionally presuppose in order even merely to be thinkable as an attempt, Reinhold calls the primordially true73) , the true and certain for itself, the ground of explanation of everything comprehensible that is true; but that with which philosophy begins must be the first comprehensible true, and indeed the true first comprehensible, which for the time being is assumed in philosophizing as striving only problematically and hypothetically; in philosophizing as knowing, however, it proves itself as the only possible first only then and insofar as it emerges with complete certainty that and why it itself, and the possibility and actuality of the cognizable as well as of cognition, are possible through the primordially true as the primordial ground of everything, which announces itself in the possible and in the actual, and how and why it is true through the primordially true, which, apart from its relation to the possible and the actual, whereon it reveals itself, is the absolutely incomprehensible, inexplicable and unnameable.74)
zh: 我们现在来谈主要预设，它最终更直接地关涉哲学思考。

哲学为了哪怕只作为尝试而可被思考就必须暂先预设的东西，赖因霍尔德称之为原初真的东西73)，即自为地真的东西和确定的东西，一切可理解的真东西的解释根据；而哲学由之开始的东西，必须是第一个可理解的真东西，而且是真的第一个可理解者，它在目前的哲学思考中作为努力只被或然地、假设地接受；但在作为知识的哲学思考中，它只有到那时、只有就下面这一点而言，才证明自己是唯一可能的第一个：以完全的确定性显明，它自身以及可认识之物的可能性和现实性、还有认识的可能性和现实性，何以通过那原初真的东西而是可能的——这原初真的东西是一切的原初根据，它在可能的东西和现实的东西上宣告自身——，以及它何以通过那原初真的东西而是真的，而那原初真的东西，除了它同可能的东西和现实的东西的关系——它在这关系中启示自身——之外，是绝对不可理解、不可解释和不可命名的东西。74)

en: One sees from this form of the absolute as something primordially true that, according to this, philosophizing is not concerned with producing knowing and truth through reason, that the absolute in the form of truth is not a work of reason, but is already in and for itself something true and certain, hence something cognized and known.

Reason can give itself no active relation to it; on the contrary, every activity of reason, every form that the absolute would receive through it, would have to be regarded as a change of the absolute, and a change of the primordially true would be the production of error.
Philosophizing accordingly means taking up into itself what is already quite finished and known with absolutely passive receptivity - and the convenience of this manner is not to be denied.

It need not be recalled that truth and certainty outside cognition - whether the latter be a faith or a knowing - is a non-entity, and that the absolute becomes something true and certain solely through the self-activity of reason.

But it becomes intelligible how strange it must appear to this convenience, which already presupposes a finished primordially true, when it is demanded that thinking raise itself to knowing through the self-activity of reason, that nature be created for consciousness through science, and that the subject-object is nothing to which it does not make itself through self-activity.

The unification of reflection and of the absolute in knowing takes place by virtue of that convenient manner entirely according to the ideal of a philosophical Utopia, in which the absolute has already prepared itself for itself into something true and known and gives itself over wholly to be enjoyed by the passivity of thinking, which need only open its mouth.

From this Utopia the laborious, assertoric and categorical creating and constructing is banished; through a problematic and hypothetical shaking, the fruits fall from the tree of cognition, which stands on the sand of grounding, already chewed and digested by themselves.

For the whole business of the reduced philosophy, which wants to be only a problematic and hypothetical attempt and something preliminary, the absolute must necessarily already be posited as primordially true and known, - how else could truth and knowing result from the problematic and the hypothetical?
zh: 从绝对者作为原初真的东西这一形式可以看出，照此说来，哲学思考并不是要凭理性生产知识和真理，绝对者在真理的形式中并不是理性的作品，而是它已经自在自为地是真的和确定的，因而是一个被认识、被知道的东西。
理性不能使自己同它发生一种能动的关系；相反，理性的任何活动、绝对者通过理性而得到的任何形式，都必须被看作对绝对者的改变，而对原初真的东西的改变就会是错误的生产。
所以，哲学思考就意味着以绝对被动的接受性把已经完全做成、已被知道的东西接纳到自身之中——而这种做法的省事是不能否认的。
不必提醒的是，真理和确定性在认识之外——不管这认识是信仰还是知识——是一种无稽之物，并且绝对者只有通过理性的自身活动才成为真的和确定的东西。
但这就变得可以理解：当要求思维通过理性的自身活动把自己提升为知识，要求通过科学为意识创造出自然，并且说主体—客体不是什么它不通过自身活动把自己造成的东西时，这种省事的做法——它已经预设了一个现成的原初真的东西——必定会显得多么奇怪。
反思和绝对者在知识中的统一，凭借那种省事的做法，完全按照一个哲学乌托邦的理想而发生：在这个乌托邦里，绝对者已经为自身把自己预备成真的东西和被知道的东西，并把自己完全交给思维的被动性去享用，而思维只需要张开嘴。
从这个乌托邦里，辛劳的、实然的、直言的创造和建构被驱逐出去；只消或然地和假设地摇一摇，果子就从认识之树上——这树立在论证的沙地上——自己嚼碎、消化好了掉下来。
对于被还原的哲学的全部事务来说——这种哲学只想是一种或然的和假设的尝试、一种暂先的东西——，绝对者必须已经必然被设定为原初真的和被知道的，——否则，真理和知识怎么可能从或然的和假设的东西中产生出来呢？

en: Since now, and insofar as, the presupposition of philosophy is the in-itself incomprehensible and primordially true, therefore and insofar it should be able to announce itself only in a comprehensible true, and philosophizing cannot start from an incomprehensible primordially true, but [must] start from a comprehensible true. - This inference is not only proved by nothing, but rather the opposite conclusion is to be drawn: if the presupposition of philosophy, the primordially true, is something incomprehensible, then the primordially true would announce itself in something comprehensible through its opposite, thus falsely.

One would rather have to say that philosophy must indeed begin, proceed and end with concepts, but with incomprehensible concepts; for in the limitation of a concept the incomprehensible is, instead of being announced, sublated, - and the unification of opposed concepts in the antinomy, for the faculty of comprehension the contradiction, is the not merely problematic and hypothetical, but, because of the immediate connection with it, its assertoric and categorical appearance and the true, through reflection possible revelation of the incomprehensible in concepts.

If according to Reinhold the absolute is something incomprehensible only outside its relation to the actual and the possible, on which it reveals itself, and is thus to be cognized in the possible and the actual, then this would be only a cognition through the understanding and no cognition of the absolute.

For reason, which intuits the relation of the actual and the possible to the absolute, thereby sublates the possible and the actual as possible and actual; before it these determinacies as well as their opposition disappear, and it thereby cognizes not the outer appearance as revelation but the essence that reveals itself, - must on the other hand cognize a concept for itself, like the abstract unity of thinking, not as an announcing of it but as a disappearing of it out of consciousness; in itself it has of course not disappeared, but out of such a speculation.
zh: 既然并且就哲学的前提是自在的不可把握者和原初的真而言，所以并且就此而言，它只应当能在一种可把握的真上宣示自身，而哲学活动不能从一种不可把握的原初的真出发，而是[必须]从一种可把握的真出发。——这个推论不仅没有被任何东西证明，而且毋宁要作出相反的结论：如果哲学的前提、即原初的真，是一个不可把握者，那么原初的真就会在一种可把握的东西上、通过它的对立面、因而虚假地宣示自身。
毋宁说必须讲：哲学固然必须从概念开始、行进并终结，但必须从不可把握的概念开始、行进并终结；因为在一个概念的限定中，不可把握者不是被宣示出来，而是被扬弃了，——而在二律背反中对立概念的统一，对把握能力来说就是矛盾，它不只是或然的和假设的显现，而且由于与不可把握者的直接关联，是其实然的和定言的显现，是不可把握者在概念中真实的、通过反思而可能的启示。
如果按照赖因霍尔德，绝对者只有在它同现实的东西和可能的东西的关系之外才是不可把握者，而它正是在这种关系上启示自身，因而是在可能的东西和现实的东西中被认识，那么这就只会是一种通过知性的认识，而不是对绝对者的认识。
因为理性直观着现实的东西和可能的东西同绝对者的关系，它恰恰因此把可能的东西和现实的东西作为可能的东西和现实的东西加以扬弃；在理性面前，这些规定性连同它们的对立都消失了，而理性由此认识的不是外在的显现之为启示，而是启示自身的本质，——反过来，理性必须把自为的一个概念、如同思维的抽象统一那样，不认作本质的宣示，而认作本质从意识中的消失；自在说来它当然并没有消失，但却是从这样一种思辨中消失。

en: We pass over to the consideration of that which is the true business of the philosophy reduced to logic.

Namely, through the analysis of the application of thinking as thinking, it is to discover and set up the primordially true together with the true, and the true through the primordially true, and we see the manifold absolutes that are required for this:
zh: 我们现在转而考察那被归结为逻辑的哲学的真正事务是什么。
也就是说，它应当通过对思维作为思维的应用的分析，去发现并建立原初的真连同真、以及通过原初的真去发现并建立真，而我们看到为此所需的形形色色的绝对者：

en: a. Thinking does not first become a thinking in the application and through the application and as something applied, but its inner character must be understood here, and this is the infinite repeatability of one and the same, in one and the same and through one and the same, - pure identity, the absolute infinity that excludes from itself all being-outside-one-another, succession and coexistence.75)
zh: a. 思维并不是在应用中、通过应用并且作为被应用者才成为思维的，毋宁说必须在这里理解它的内在特性，而这特性就是同一个东西的无限可重复性，在同一个东西中、并通过同一个东西，——纯粹的同一性，那种把一切彼此外在、先后相继和并立并存都从自身排除出去的绝对的无限性。75)

en: b. A quite other thing than thinking itself is the application of thinking; as certainly as thinking itself is by no means the application of thinking, so certainly must, in the application and through it, to thinking -
zh: b. 思维的应用是与思维本身完全不同的另一种东西；思维本身绝不是思维的应用，这一点有多确定，在应用中并通过应用、向着思维就必定同样确定地——

en: c. a third thing be added = C, the matter of the application of thinking;76) this materiality, partly annihilated in thinking, partly fitting itself to it, is postulated, and the warrant and the necessity for assuming and presupposing matter lies in this, that thinking could impossibly be applied if there were not a matter.

Since now matter cannot be what thinking is - for if it were the same, it would not be an other and no application would take place, because the inner character of thinking is unity -, so the inner character of matter is the one opposed to that, manifoldness.77) - What formerly was simply accepted as empirically given is, since Kantian times, postulated, and that is what is then called remaining immanent; only in the subjective - the objective must be postulated - are empirically given laws, forms, or whatever else one likes, still permitted under the name of facts of consciousness.
zh: c. 还要有第三个东西加进来 = C，即思维应用的材料76)；这种在思维中一部分被消灭、一部分与思维相配合的材料性是被公设起来的，而采取并预设材料的权限和必然性就在于：如果没有材料，思维根本不可能被应用。

既然材料不能是思维所是的东西——因为如果它是同一个东西，它就不会是另一个东西，也就不会有什么应用，因为思维的内在特性是统一性——，那么材料的内在特性就是与前一个相对立的那一个，即杂多。77)——从前直截了当被当作经验给予的东西接受下来的东西，自康德的时代以来是被公设起来的，而这就叫做保持内在；只有在主观的东西中——客观的东西必须是被公设的——，经验给予的规律、形式，或者人们随便叫它什么的东西，才还能以意识的事实之名被允许。

en: As regards first thinking, Reinhold, as already recalled above, locates the fundamental error of all more recent philosophy in the fundamental prejudice and bad habit of taking thinking for a merely subjective activity, and requests, merely by way of attempt, for the time being to abstract from all subjectivity and objectivity of it.

But it is not difficult to see that - as soon as thinking is posited in the pure, i.e. from materiality abstracting, hence opposed unity, and then, as is necessary, there follows upon this abstraction the postulate of a matter essentially different from thinking and independent of it - that fundamental error and fundamental prejudice itself emerges in its full strength.

Thinking here is essentially not the identity of subject and object, whereby it is characterized as the activity of reason and is thereby at the same time abstracted from all subjectivity and objectivity only by being both at once, but the object is a matter postulated for thinking, and thereby thinking is nothing other than something subjective.

If one wanted therefore to do the request the favor of abstracting from the subjectivity of thinking and positing it as subjective and objective at once and thus at once with neither of these predicates, this is not permitted; rather, through the opposing of something objective, it is determined as something subjective, and the absolute opposition is made the theme and principle of the philosophy that has fallen into reduction through logic.
zh: 首先就思维来说，如上面已经提到过的，赖因霍尔德把一切较新哲学的根本错误放在那个根本偏见和坏习惯里，即把思维看作一种单纯主观的活动，并且请求人们——只是为了试一试——暂且从思维的一切主观性和客观性中抽象出来。
但是不难看出：一旦思维被设定为纯粹的、亦即从材料性中抽象出来的、因而与之相对立的统一性，并且如必然的那样，在这一抽象之上随之出现一个与思维本质上不同并且不依赖于思维的材料这一公设，那么那个根本错误和根本偏见本身就以全部力量显露出来了。
在这里，思维本质上不是主体与客体的同一性——思维正是借此被规定为理性的活动，并且同时只有通过它同时是两者，才从一切主观性和客观性中抽象出来——，毋宁说客体是为思维而公设起来的材料，而思维由此不外是某种主观的东西。
因此，即使人们愿意满足这一请求，从思维的主观性中抽象出来，把思维设定为同时既是主观的又是客观的、因而同时不带这两个谓词中的任何一个，这也不会被允许；相反，通过把一个客观的东西与之对立起来，思维被规定为某种主观的东西，而绝对的对立则被弄成那通过逻辑而落入归结还原的哲学的主题和原则。

en: According to this principle, then, synthesis too falls away.

It is expressed by a popular word as an application, and even in this meagre shape, for which not much can fall to synthesizing out of two absolutely opposed things, it does not agree with the claim that the first theme of philosophy should be something comprehensible; for even the slight synthesis of applying contains a transition of unity into the manifold, a unification of thinking and matter, and thus includes within itself a so-called incomprehensible.

In order to be able to synthesize it, thinking and matter would have to be posited not as absolutely opposed but as originally one, and with that we would be at the tiresome identity of subject and object, transcendental intuition, intellectual thinking.
zh: 按照这一原则，综合也就落空了。
人们用一个通俗的词把它表达为一种应用，而即便在这种贫乏的形态中——从两个绝对对立的东西那里，能落到综合头上的东西并不多——，它也同哲学的第一个主题应当是某种可把握的东西这一点不相符；因为就连应用这种微不足道的综合也包含着统一性向杂多的过渡、思维与材料的结合，因而自身就包含着一个所谓的不可把握者。
为了能够对它进行综合，思维和材料就必须不被设定为绝对对立的，而被设定为原初是一体的，这样一来我们就又落到那个令人厌烦的主体与客体的同一性、先验直观、智性的思维上了。

en: Yet Reinhold has not brought forward in this preceding and introductory exposition everything that can serve, from the Outline of Logic, to mitigate that kind of difficulty which lies in the absolute opposition.

Namely, the Outline postulates, besides the postulated matter and its deduced manifoldness, also an inner capacity and aptitude of matter to be thought; alongside the materiality that must be annihilated in thinking, still something that cannot be annihilated through thinking, which is also not missing from the perceptions of horses, - a form independent of thinking, to which, because according to the law of nature form cannot be destroyed by form, the form of thinking has to accommodate itself; besides the unthinkable materiality, the thing-in-itself, an absolute representable stuff that is independent of the one representing but in the representation is related to the form.78) This relating of the form to the stuff Reinhold always calls application of thinking and avoids the expression "representing", which Bardili uses for it.
For it has been asserted that the Outline of Logic is nothing but the warmed-up elementary philosophy.

It does not appear that the intention was ascribed to Reinhold, as if he had wanted to reintroduce into the philosophical world, in this barely altered form, the elementary philosophy no longer sought in the philosophical public; rather that the pure receiving and pure learning of logic had, unwittingly, really gone to school with itself.

Reinhold opposes to this view of the matter the following grounds of proof in the Contributions: that he, first, instead of seeking his elementary philosophy in the Outline of Logic, saw in it a "kinship with idealism", and indeed, on account of the bitter mockery with which Bardili mentions the Reinholdian theory on every occasion, had rather suspected every other philosophy in it;
zh: 不过赖因霍尔德在这段前面的、导论性的阐述中，并没有把《逻辑纲要》(Grundriß der Logik) 里能够用来缓和绝对的对立所包含的那类困难的一切都提出来。

也就是说，《逻辑纲要》除了那被公设的材料和它被演绎出来的杂多之外，还公设了材料的一种内在的能力和适应性，即被思维的能力；在思维中必须被消灭的材料性之外，还公设了某种不能通过思维被消灭的东西，它在马匹的感知中也不缺少，——一种不依赖于思维的形式，而由于按照自然的规律形式不能通过形式被毁灭，思维的形式就必须顺从这种形式；除了不可思维的材料性、即物自体之外，还公设了一种绝对的、可表象的质料，它不依赖于表象者，但在表象中被联系到形式。78)把形式联系到质料这种做法，赖因霍尔德总是称之为思维的应用，而避开巴尔迪利用来表示它的“表象”一词。
因为有人断言，《逻辑纲要》无非是重新热过的基础哲学。
看来人们并没有把这样的意图归给赖因霍尔德，仿佛他想把那种在哲学公众中已不再有人问津的基础哲学，以这种几乎没有改动的形式重新引入哲学界；毋宁说，那种对逻辑的纯粹接受和纯粹学习，不知不觉间其实是在自己那里上学。
赖因霍尔德在《论集》里对这种事情的看法提出了如下证明理由：第一，他并不是在自己的基础哲学中去寻找《逻辑纲要》，而是在其中看到了“与观念论有亲缘关系”，并且由于巴尔迪利一有机会就用尖刻的嘲讽提到赖因霍尔德的学说，他倒是在其中猜想到任何一种别的哲学；

en: - that the words representation, represented, and mere representation etc. occur in the Outline throughout in a sense that is throughout opposed to the one in which they were used by the author of the elementary philosophy, as he surely must know best;
zh: ——即《逻辑纲要》中“表象”、“被表象者”和“单纯的表象”等词，完全是在一种与基础哲学的作者使用它们时的含义处处相反的含义下出现的，而这一点他大概最清楚不过；

en: - by the assertion that that Outline, even in any conceivable sense, [is] a reworking of the Reinholdian elementary philosophy, whoever asserts this evidently shows that he has not understood what he judged.79)
zh: ——通过“那部《逻辑纲要》哪怕在任何一种可以设想的含义上[也]是对赖因霍尔德基础哲学的改写”这一断言，提出这一断言的人显然表明，他并没有理解他所评判的东西。79)

en: On the first ground, the bitter mockery, there is no further need to enter.
The remaining ones are assertions whose cogency will emerge from a brief comparison of the main moments of the theory80) with the Outline.
zh: 对于第一个理由，即尖刻的嘲讽，不必再作深究。
其余的都是断言，它们的说服力将从对理论的主要环节80)与《逻辑纲要》作一简短比较中得出。

en: According to the theory, there belongs to representing, as inner condition, an essential constituent of the representation
zh: 按照理论，属于表象活动、作为内在条件的，是表象的一个本质组成部分

en: a. a material of the representation, that which is given to receptivity, whose form is manifoldness;
zh: a. 表象的一种材料，即被给予接受性的东西，其形式是杂多；

en: b. a form of the representation, that which is produced by spontaneity, whose form is unity.81)
zh: b. 表象的一种形式，即由自发性产生出来的东西，其形式是统一性。81)

en: In the logic:
zh: 在逻辑学中：

en: a. a thinking, an activity, whose fundamental character is unity,
zh: a. 一种思维、一种活动，其根本特征是统一性，

en: b. a matter, whose character is manifoldness;
zh: b. 一种质料，其特征是杂多；

en: c. the relating of the two to each other is called representing in the theory and in the logic, only that Reinhold always says application of thinking.
Form and material, thinking and matter, subsist in both in the same way for themselves.
zh: c. 把两者互相联系起来，在理论和逻辑学中都叫做表象，只不过赖因霍尔德总说成是思维的应用。
形式和材料、思维和质料，在两者中同样都是自为地存在的。

en: As for matter, further,
zh: 至于质料，还有

en: a. one part of it is, in the theory and in the logic, the thing-in-itself, there the object itself insofar as it is not representable82), - but as little as the representable objects themselves can be denied83), here the materiatur, which must be annihilated in thinking, the unthinkable of matter.
zh: a. 它的一个部分，在理论和逻辑学中都是物自体，在理论中是对象本身，就它是不可表象的而言82)，——但它正如可表象的对象本身一样不可否认83)，在逻辑学中则是质料性，它在思维中必须被消灭掉，是质料中不可思维的东西。

en: b. The other part of the object is in the theory the familiar material of the representation84), in the logic the form of the object that is independent of thinking and ineradicable85), to which the form of thinking must accommodate itself, because form cannot annihilate form.
zh: b. 对象的另一个部分，在理论中是那个已知的表象材料84)，在逻辑学中则是不依赖于思维、不可根除的85)对象形式，思维的形式必须顺从它，因为形式不能消灭形式。

en: And over this twofoldness of the object - now an absolute materiatur for thinking, with which thinking knows not how to accommodate itself but knows nothing to do except to annihilate it, that is, to abstract from it, now a constitution that again belongs to the object independently of all thinking, but a form that makes it fit to be thought, with which thinking must accommodate itself as well as it can - thinking is supposed to plunge into life.86) In philosophy thinking arrives out of the plunge into such an absolute duality with a broken neck, - a duality that can change its forms infinitely, but always gives birth to one and the very same unphilosophy.

In this newly issued theory of his own doctrine Reinhold finds - not unlike that man who, to his greatest satisfaction, was unwittingly served from his own cellar - all hopes and wishes fulfilled that philosophical revolutions in the new century have ended, so that now the philosophical eternal peace can enter immediately in the universally valid reduction of philosophy through logic.
zh: 而对于对象的这种二重性——一方面是对于思维绝对的材料性，思维不知如何顺从它，只知道把它消灭掉，也就是从它抽象出来；另一方面是一种又独立于一切思维而属于对象的性状，但却是一种形式，它使对象适宜于被思维，思维必须尽可能顺从它——思维据说要凭它一头扎进生命里去。86) 在哲学中，思维从这一跃中跌出来时，是带着折断的脖子到达这样一种绝对二元性的，——这种二元性可以无限地变换自己的形式，却始终生出同一个非哲学。
在这部重新出版的自己学说的理论中，赖因霍尔德发现——与那个从自己的地窖里被人在不知情中款待、并为此极为满意的人不无相似——一切希望和愿望都已实现：新世纪的哲学革命已经结束，于是现在，通过逻辑学对哲学的普遍有效的还原，哲学的永久和平可以立刻到来。

en: This new work in the philosophical vineyard Reinhold begins, as otherwise the political journal did each of its pieces, with the narrative that it had turned out differently and yet again differently than he had predicted: 'Differently than he announced it at the beginning of the revolution; differently than he sought in the middle of it to further its progress, differently than toward the end of it he believed its goal attained; he asks whether he is not deceiving himself for the fourth time.'87) - Otherwise, if the multitude of deceptions can make the calculation of probability easier and can come into consideration with regard to what one calls an authority, then from the contributions before this one, which was to be no real one, one can count up several more to those three recognized ones:
zh: 在这座哲学的葡萄园里的新工作，赖因霍尔德是这样开头的——就像当年那份政治杂志对它的每一篇所做的那样——他说结果和他预先讲的又不一样、再一次不一样：“和他在这场革命开头所宣告的不一样；和他在这场革命中途为推进它的进程所谋求的不一样；和他在这场革命临近结尾时以为它已达到目标的不一样；他问，自己是不是第四次弄错了。”87)——往常，如果受骗的次数能使或然性的计算变得容易些，并且在考虑到人们所谓权威的东西时能算数，那么从这篇——据说并不是现实的权威——之前的那些文稿里，人们还可以在那已经认出的三次之外再数出好几次：

en: - namely, according to p. 126, Reinhold had to abandon forever the intermediate standpoint between the Fichtean and the Jacobian philosophy, which he believed he had found;
zh: ——即按照第126页，赖因霍尔德不得不永远放弃那个他以为已经找到了的、介于费希特哲学和雅可比哲学之间的中间立场；

en: - he believed, wished, etc. (p. 129), that the essential of Bardili's philosophy could be traced back to the essential of Fichte's and conversely, and in all seriousness he set about persuading Bardili that he was an idealist.
But not only was Bardili not to be persuaded, on the contrary Reinhold was compelled by Bardili's letters (p. 130) to give up idealism altogether;
zh: ——他相信、希望等等（第129页），巴尔迪利哲学的本质可以回溯到费希特哲学的本质，反过来也一样，并且他一本正经地着手说服巴尔迪利，说他是个观念论者。
但不只是巴尔迪利无法被说服，相反，赖因霍尔德被巴尔迪利的来信（第130页）逼得干脆放弃了观念论；

en: - since the attempt with Bardili had failed, he urgently commended the Outline to Fichte (p. 163), where he exclaims: "What a triumph for the good cause, if Fichte were to press through the bulwark of his letter and yours (Bardili's) all the way to unity with you!" - How it turned out is known.
zh: ——由于同巴尔迪利的尝试失败了，他又急切地把《纲要》推荐给费希特（第163页），并且喊道：“如果费希特能穿过他和你（巴尔迪利）的字面的堡垒，一直钻到与你的统一，那对善良事业该是多大的胜利！”——结果如何，是众所周知的。

en: Finally, with regard to the historical views it must not be forgotten either that it is otherwise than Reinhold thought, when he believed he saw the whole system in one part of Schelling's philosophy and took this philosophy for what one usually calls idealism.
zh: 最后，就历史方面的看法来说，也不可忘记：事情和赖因霍尔德所想的不一样，因为他曾在谢林哲学的一个部分里以为看到了整个体系，并且把这种哲学当成了人们通常所说的观念论。

en: How it will finally turn out with the logical reduction of philosophy, about that it is not easy to predict anything.
The invention is too useful for keeping oneself outside philosophy and yet philosophizing for it not to be desirable; only it carries its own judgment with it.
For because it must choose some one among many possible forms of the standpoint of reflection, it stands in everyone's discretion to create another one for himself.

Something like that is then called displacing an old system by a new one, and must be so called, because the form of reflection must be taken for the essence of the system; thus Reinhold himself too was able to see a different system in Bardili's logic than in his theory.
zh: 哲学的“逻辑学还原”最终会有什么结果，这一点不容易预先说什么。
这一发明用来让自己留在哲学之外、同时又在做哲学，实在太有用了，不会不被人欢迎；只是它自带自己的判决。
因为它必须在反思立场的许多可能形式中挑选某一种，所以随便谁都乐意给自己造出另一种来。
这种东西于是就叫作用一个新体系挤掉一个旧体系，而且必须这样叫，因为反思的形式被当成了体系的本质；所以赖因霍尔德自己也能够在巴尔迪利的逻辑学里看到一个不同于他的《理论》的体系。

en: The tendency to ground, which aims at tracing philosophy back to logic, must take its necessary and determinate objective place in the manifoldness of the strivings of culture that relate to philosophy, but give themselves a firm shape before they arrive at philosophy itself, as a phenomenon of one side of the general need of philosophy that fixes itself.

The absolute in the line of its development, which it produces up to the completion of itself, must at the same time arrest itself at every point and organize itself into a shape, and in this manifoldness it appears as forming itself.
zh: 那种要把哲学回溯到逻辑学上去的论证倾向，必须作为一种自行固定下来的现象、作为哲学的一般需要的一个方面的现象，在那些与哲学相关、但在达到哲学本身之前就给自己一个固定形态的教养追求之杂多中，占据它必然而确定的对象位置。
绝对者在它发展的线索中——它在这条线索上把自己一直产生到自身的完成——必须同时在每一点上使自己停住，并把自己组织成一个形态，而在这个杂多中它是作为自行形成者而出现的。

en: When the need of philosophy does not reach its centre, it shows the two sides of the absolute, which is inner and outer, essence and appearance at the same time, as separated, - the inner essence and the outer appearance each on its own.

Outer appearance for itself becomes an absolutely objective totality, the manifoldness scattered into infinity, which in its striving after the infinite multitude gives evidence of its unconscious connection with the absolute, and one must render the unscientific effort the justice that it does in that respect [somewhat] sense the need of a totality, in that it strives to spread the empirical out into infinity, although precisely thereby the material necessarily becomes very thin in the end.

This effort with the infinite objective material forms the opposite pole to the pole of density, which strives to remain in the inner essence and cannot get out of the contraction of its solid material into scientific expansion.

The former brings into the death of the essence that it treats, through infinite busyness, to be sure not a life, but still a stirring, and if the Danaids, because of the eternal running out of the water, never reach fullness, those efforts, by contrast, do not, in that through the constant pouring in they give their sea an infinite breadth; if they do not attain the satisfaction of finding nothing more that would be unpoured, the busyness just in that way receives eternal nourishment on the immeasurable surface; standing firm on the common saying that no created spirit penetrates into the inner being of nature88), it gives up creating spirit and an inner being and quickening the dead into nature. - The enthusiast's inner gravity, on the other hand, scorns the water, through whose addition to the density it could crystallize into shape; the fermenting urge, which stems from the natural necessity to produce a shape, rejects its possibility and dissolves nature into spirits, forms it into shapeless shapes, or, if reflection predominates over the imagination, genuine scepticism arises.
zh: 当哲学的需要达不到自己的中心时，它就显示出绝对者的两个方面是分离的，——绝对者同时既是内在的东西又是外在的东西，既是本质又是现象，——即内在的本质和外在的现象各自分开。
外在的现象自为地成为绝对客观的总体性，成为散入无限之中的杂多，这种杂多在追求无限数量的努力中，透露出自己与绝对者的无意识的联系；而人们必须还那种非科学的努力一个公道，承认它就此而言[多少]感觉到了总体性的需要，即它力求把经验的东西向无限之外扩展，尽管正因如此，材料在最后必然变得非常稀薄。
这种与无限客观材料打交道的努力，构成了与致密性那一极相对立的另一极，而致密性力求停留在内在的本质之中，无法从自己坚实材料的收缩中走出来，进入科学的扩展。

前者通过无限的忙碌，给它所处理的本质之死带来的虽然不是生命，却也是一种动静；如果说达那伊得斯由于水永远流走而从来达不到充盈，那么那些努力反倒不会如此，因为它们通过不断注入，给自己的海洋带来无限的广度；如果说它们达不到那种满足——再也找不到什么东西是未被浇灌的——那么忙碌恰恰就在这上面，在无边无际的表面上获得永恒的营养；它固守那句老话，说任何被创造的精神都钻不进自然的内部88)，于是放弃去创造精神和一种内在的东西，也放弃把死的东西激活为自然。——而狂热者的内在重力却鄙弃水，因为水一旦加入致密性，它就有可能结晶为形态；那种发酵般的冲动来自要产生一种形态的自然必然性，它拒绝这种可能性，把自然分解为诸多精神，把自然塑造成无形态的形态，或者，如果反思压过了想象力，就产生出真正的怀疑论。

en: A false centre between the two is formed by a popular and formula philosophy, which has grasped neither and therefore believes it can so oblige them that the principle of each would remain in its essence and through a modification the two would nestle into one another.
It does not grasp both poles in itself, but in a superficial modification and neighbourly union the essence of both escapes it, and it is alien to both as well as to philosophy.

It has the principle of opposition from the pole of dispersal, but the opposed are not to be mere appearances and concepts into infinity, but one of them is also to be an infinite and incomprehensible [thing]; thus the enthusiast's need for a supersensible was to be satisfied.
But the principle of dispersal scorns the supersensible, just as the principle of enthusiasm scorns the opposition of the supersensible and any subsistence of something limited alongside it.

Likewise every semblance of a centre that popular philosophy gives to its principle of the absolute non-identity of a finite and an infinite is rejected by philosophy, which raises the death of the dirempted to life through absolute identity and, through reason, which devours both into itself and posits both equally maternally, strives after the consciousness of this identity of the finite and the infinite, that is, after knowledge and truth.
zh: 两者之间的一种虚假的中心，是由一种通俗哲学和公式哲学构成的，它两者都没有把握住，因此以为可以这样讨两者的好：让每一方的原则保留在自己的本质之中，再通过一种改动使两者彼此贴合到一起。
它并没有在自己之中把握住两极，而是在一种表面的改动和邻近的结合中，两者的本质从它那里消失了，于是它对两者、也对哲学都是陌生的。
它从分散那一极取得了对立的原则，但对立的两方不应只是无限延伸的现象和概念，其中一方还应当是一个无限的、不可理解的东西；这样一来，狂热者对超感性之物的需要就该得到满足了。
但分散的原则鄙弃超感性之物，正如狂热的原则鄙弃超感性之物的对立、鄙弃任何有限之物在超感性之物旁边的持存。
同样，通俗哲学赋予其有限者与无限者之绝对非同一性这一原则的任何中心点假象，都被哲学抛弃，而哲学通过绝对同一性把分裂双方之死提升为生命，并凭借那把它两者都吞入自身、又对两者同样慈母般地加以设定的理性，去追求对这种有限者与无限者之同一性的意识，也就是追求知识和真理。
